name: Scroll Speed
description:
Set the speed of the mouse wheel, the setting GNOME does not have: slower, faster, a separate horizontal speed and optional acceleration when the wheel spins fast. Works in every application, Wayland and X11 alike.

A compositor hands wheel events to applications before an extension can touch them, so the speed is changed where the events come from: a small Python helper (standard library only, bundled) reads the mouse and replays it through a virtual mouse with the wheel rescaled. This needs one authorization, asked from the preferences, which installs a udev rule giving your session access to mice and to /dev/uinput. Touchpads and pointing sticks are not affected.
